title: AI Backend Terminology
description: Build a solid mental model of the terms, concepts, and ecosystem you will use when adding AI to .NET backends.
longDescription: Before writing code, you need a shared vocabulary. This module explains embeddings, vector stores, tokens, prompts, RAG, agents, tool calling, MCP, and the popular .NET libraries you will use throughout the course.
whatYouLearn: Explain embeddings, vectors, and similarity search in plain language
Distinguish RAG from fine-tuning and prompt engineering
Describe what MCP is and why it matters for .NET backends
Compare popular .NET AI libraries and their intended use cases
Use the correct vocabulary when discussing AI backend architecture
